annotations.title: Prepare Midnight Take Repay Withdraw Collateral

description: Prepare repaying Midnight debt before maturity by buying back units from the best ask offers, then optionally withdrawing collateral, in one MidnightBundlesV2 transaction. First call `morpho_midnight_get_user_position` for the debt and collateral and `morpho_midnight_get_book_quote` with side `asks` and the same amount. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Loan token amount to spend buying back debt, in human-readable decimals

collateralAmount.description: Collateral token amount to withdraw after the repay, in human-readable decimals, or "max" for the full balance. Omit to only repay.

collateralIndex.description: Index of the collateral in the market `collaterals` list

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

slippage.description: Slippage percentage applied to the book quote (e.g. "0.5" = 0.5%). Bounds the units filled at the quoted average price.

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_take_repay_withdraw_collateral
